item.title: Proteas Men Set for Historic T20i Pink Day Send-off
item.description: JOHANNESBURG: Cricket South Africa is set to deliver an unforgettable Pink Day when the Proteas Men host the West Indies in the final KFC T20 International (T20I) at a sold-out DP World Wanderers Stadium in Johannesburg on Saturday, 31 January. The match will mark the first time the national side takes the field in a T20I wearing pink as they stand united in the fight to beat breast cancer.
